editorial.blurb: Han Mi Jeong brings Korean comfort food to Halsted with generous family-style portions and less common dishes like jokbal, though execution can be inconsistent.
editorial.insiderTip: Order during lunch specials (~$16) instead of dinner ($20+) for better value, and skip the kampoongki—reviewers found it over-fried and gluey. The spicy pork and fried chicken are crowd-pleasers with massive leftovers.
